senses.gloss:
गुर् गुर्, i. 6, Ātm. (also Par. Man. 4, 169), and i. 10, गोरय, Ātm.; also गूर् गूर्, i. 10, Ātm. To make an effort.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To assault, Man. 4, 169.
 --With उद् उद्, ptcple. of the pf. pass., उद्गूर्ण, Raised, Yājñ. 2, 215.

† गूर् गूर्, i. 4, Ātm. To injure.
 --Cf. गुर्.

गुरु गुर् + उ (for original, गर्-उ; cf. compar. गर् + ईयंस्, βαρύ),
 I. adj., f. गुर्वि,
 1. Heavy, MBh. 3, 885.
 2. Great, Bhartṛ. 2, 50; large, Pañc. 51, 8.
 3. Violent, Vikr. d. 6.
 4. Weighty, Brāhmaṇ. 2, 6; important, Man. 9, 52.
 5. Dear, MBh. i, 2749.
 6. Venerable, Man. 2, 133.
 II. m. and f. A father or mother, a husband, or any venerable male or female relation, Rām. 1, 22, 20; Sāv. 4, 22; Sund. 4, 15.
 III. m.
 1. A spiritual teacher, Man. 2, 142.
 2. An object of veneration Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 868. Compar.
 1. गुरुतर. Heavier, MBh. 3, 13292; fem. तरा, MBh. 1, 3267 (तरी, Indr. 5, 41, is to be changed to [] तरा, according to the Calc. ed. 3, 1857).
 2. गरीयंस्, Very heavy, Rām. 6, 82, 43.
 3. Preferable, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 910. Superl. गुरुतम, गरिष्ठ.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. βαρύς, etc., ἐπι-ζαρέω; Lat. gravis; Goth. kaurs, kauritha; A.S. caru; Engl. care.
गुरुक गुरु + क, adj. A little heavy, MBh. 3, 11477.
गुरुतल्पग गुरु-तल्प-ग, m. A violator of the bed of his guru, i. e. his father or teacher, Man. 9, 63.
गुरुतल्पिन् गुरुतल्पिन्, i. e. गुरु-तल्प + इन्, m. A violator of the bed of his guru, i. e. his father or teacher, Man. 11, 103.

गुरुता गुरु + ता, f.
 1. Heaviness, Śāk. d. 35.
 2. Molestation, Rām. 2, 27, 22.
 3. Importance, Śiś. 9, 22.
 4. The condition of a teacher, Kathās. 19, 75.

गुरुत्व गुरु + त्व, n.
 1. Heaviness, Pañc. 247, 13.
 2. Dignity, Ragh. 10, 65.
 3. The condition of a teacher, Chr. 22, 21.
गुरुत्वक गुरुत्व + क, n. Heaviness, Bhāṣāp. 4.
गुरुलघुता गुरु-लघु + ता, f. The condition of being wealthy or poor, Bhartṛ. 2, 37.
गुरुवत् गुरु + वत्, adv. Like a preceptor, Man. 2, 208.
गुर्जर गुर्जर, m. The name of a country, Guzarat, Pañc. 229, 2.
† गुर्द् गुर्द्, or गूर्द् गूर्द्, i. 1, गूर्द, Ātm. To play.
गूर्द् गूर्द्, see गुर्द्.

† गुर्व् गुर्व्, i. 1, गूर्व, Par. To endeavour.
 --Cf. गुर्.
गुर्विणी गुर्विणी (a dialect. fem. of गुरु), f. A pregnant woman. MBh. 14, 1843.
गुरु- + जन गुरु- + जन, m. a venerable person, as one's parents or spiritual teacher, Bhartṛ. 2, 19.
गुरु-जिगीष गुरु-जिगीष, adj. wishing to surpass, emulating the venerable, Kathās. 21, 81.
गुरु- + तल्प गुरु- + तल्प, m. one who violates the bed of his guru, i. e. of his father or teacher, Man. 9, 237.
गुरु- + पत्नी गुरु- + पत्नी, f. a mother-in-law, 9, 57.
गुरु- + पाद गुरु- + पाद, m. the feet of a guru, i. e. of the parents or of the spiritual teacher, instead of गुरु, Bhartṛ. 2, 55.
गुरु- + लाघव गुरु- + लाघव, n. the relative weight, Man. 9, 229.
गुरु- + वर्तिन् गुरु- + वर्तिन्, adj. one who behaves respectfully towards his parents and spiritual teacher, ib. 4, 35, 12.
गुरु- + वृत्त गुरु- + वृत्त, adj. one who treats [] respectfully his parents and spiritual teacher, Rām. 4, 17, 36.
गुरु- + व्यथ गुरु- + व्यथ, adj. afflicted by heavy pains, Vikr. d. 50.
